source_of_truth.inspection_method: direct read-only SQL metadata + procedure definition parsing
source_of_truth.notes: Google Sheet data intentionally ignored. Stored procedures were not executed on live.

live_execution_evidence.pre_execution_blocker_check: no active blockers returned from sys.dm_exec_requests

intent_type_definitions.aggregated_sales_target: Trend/summary analytics, all-team totals, sales vs target, YoY-style comparisons.
intent_type_definitions.incentive_analytics: Incentive earned/deduction/net and achievement by employee/role/team.

multi_match_policy.reason: Avoid high-cost misroutes and semantic mismatches between sales-target and incentive domains.

ambiguity_templates.question: Do you need product totals only (aggregated) or customer-level product details (detailed sales)?
Are you asking for sales target achievement or incentive achievement?
Do you want month-by-month trend totals or a row-level list by customer/brick/distributor?

precedence_order: If incentive terms are present, prefer Sp_PharmaCRM_GetIncentiveProcessReport unless prompt explicitly asks sales trend/volume/revenue outputs.
If customer/brick/distributor-level entities are explicitly requested, prefer SS_sp_CustomerSales_YTD_Excel.
If aggregate trend/YoY/sales-vs-target is requested, prefer Sp_PharmaCRM_SVT.

profiles.purpose: Returns detailed sales units and values at entity level for team-scoped customer sales analysis with dynamic month columns.
input_intent: Who bought what and how much
profiles.output_grain: One row per Team x Customer x Brick x Product x DistributorType x Distributor, with dynamic month unit/value columns.

result_sets.description: Final dynamic detail dataset with monthly pivot-style columns for units and values.
result_sets.row_grain: Team x Customer x Brick x Product x DistributorType x Distributor
result_sets.notes: Procedure prints dynamic SQL/debug lines; router should treat only final tabular SELECT as analytical output.

filters_supported.@FromYear/@FromMonth/@ToYear/@ToMonth: Inclusive date window by month range.
filters_supported.@DistributorType: 0 means no filter; maps 'Direct Sales to Patient' to 'Patient' internally.
filters_supported.@TeamID: Single or CSV; '0' means all teams allowed for role scope.
filters_supported.@UserRole/@EntUserEmpID: Role-aware team scoping; non-admin users constrained by TblEmpTeamsNew.

date_logic.computation: Uses DATEFROMPARTS and EOMONTH to build full-month inclusive range.
date_logic.fiscal_assumption: No explicit fiscal-year boundary enforcement in procedure.

risk_drivers: Entity-level row explosion over broad scopes
performance_risk.safe_pattern_hint: Best for single/few teams and constrained month windows with optional product/customer filters.
performance_risk.runtime_evidence: Single team single month run observed around 9.2s.
performance_risk.live_runtime: 4.63s narrow live sample: team 1, product 0010550, Jul 2025

anti_patterns.pattern: All teams + long range + detail rows
anti_patterns.why_bad: High cardinality and heavy dynamic aggregation can stall or time out.

anti_patterns.pattern: YoY or pure trend-only analytics using detailed SP
anti_patterns.why_bad: Returns unnecessary entity-level rows instead of concise trend series.

routing_rules.when: Prompt asks customer-level, brick-level, distributor-level, or who-bought-what detail.
routing_rules.reason: This SP is designed for granular row-level sales detail.

routing_rules.when: Prompt asks only aggregate totals/trends/YoY without entity breakdown.
routing_rules.reason: Aggregated SP is semantically correct and lower cost.

example_prompts_positive: Top 10 customers by revenue for Team X in Jan 2025.
Which customers bought Viracure in Q1 2025 for Team 1?
Show brick-wise sales breakdown for my team in Aug 2025.
Distributor-wise units for Betagenic Cream in Team 5 this month.
List customer-product sales rows for Team 2 between Jul and Sep 2025.
example_prompts_negative: Total net revenue for all teams in calendar year 2025.
Sales vs target achievement for Team Alpha this fiscal year.
Incentive summary for all teams in Aug 2025.
clarification_questions: Do you need customer-level detail rows or just aggregate totals?
Should I include all teams or only specific team(s)?
Do you want sales detail output or sales-vs-target trend output?

profiles.purpose: Returns aggregated sales and target analytics for fiscal-period comparisons, including current FY, previous FY, targets, product TP matrix, and distributor finalization coverage.
profiles.output_grain: Primarily month-level aggregated rows for selected scope, plus product-level TP matrix and one coverage scalar.

result_sets.description: Current fiscal year monthly actual trend.
result_sets.row_grain: One row per month in current fiscal range

result_sets.description: Previous fiscal year monthly actual trend.
result_sets.row_grain: One row per month for prior-year aligned fiscal range

result_sets.description: Current fiscal year target trend and as-on-date target overlays.
result_sets.row_grain: One row per month in current fiscal range

filters_supported.@Param_InvoiceDate_From/@Param_InvoiceDa: Fiscal period anchors (used directly in fact filters).
filters_supported.@Param_MonthID: Month cutoff logic for finalized-date handling.
filters_supported.@EmpID/@UserRole: Used to resolve territory scope when territory filter missing.

date_logic.computation: Generates month series via FN_GETDATES_BETWEEN_DATERANGE; compares current and prior fiscal windows.
date_logic.important: Fact filters rely on exact fiscal from/to matching in target and sales tables.

risk_drivers: Wide all-team scopes with many geo/product combinations
Role/territory expansion path via global temp (##TerritoryIds)
performance_risk.safe_pattern_hint: Best for aggregate trend questions and sales-vs-target summaries.
performance_risk.runtime_evidence: Single team full fiscal-year run observed around 5.38s.
performance_risk.live_runtime: 5.38s narrow live sample: team 1, territory 939, FY 2025/2026

anti_patterns.why_bad: SP does not return customer/brick rows.
No incentive payout fields in outputs.

routing_rules.when: Prompt asks monthly trends, all-team totals, sales vs target, or YoY-like comparisons.
routing_rules.reason: This SP is explicitly designed for aggregated sales/target analytics across fiscal windows.

routing_rules.when: Prompt asks for customer/distributor-level record listings.
routing_rules.reason: Need entity-level detail output unavailable in SVT.

example_prompts_positive: Total net revenue for all teams Jan-Dec 2024.
Show month-by-month revenue trend for Team X in FY 2025/2026.
Sales vs target for Team Alpha this fiscal year.
All teams combined revenue for Feb 2026.
example_prompts_negative: Top 10 customers by revenue for Team X in Jan 2025.
Which customers bought product Y this month?
What is my net incentive for Aug 2025?
clarification_questions: Do you want aggregate trend totals or detailed customer rows?
Should this be sales-vs-target analytics or incentive analytics?
Is the requested time window fiscal-year based or calendar-year based?

profiles.purpose: Returns incentive-focused analytics with monthly pivot columns and YTD summaries at employee, role, and team levels.
profiles.output_grain: Three result sets: employee-level summary, role-level summary, team-level summary; each includes YTD metrics plus month pivot columns.

result_sets.description: Employee-level incentive summary with geo hierarchy.
result_sets.row_grain: Team x Employee x Role x Region/District/Territory

columns.name: TeamName, EmployeeCode, EmployeeName, Role, Region, District, Territory
YTD Sales Target (Rs.), YTD Sales Achievement (Rs.), YTD Achievement %, YTD Total Earned Incentive (Rs.), YTD Total Deduction (Rs.), YTD Net Incentive (Rs.)
TeamName, Role, YTD metrics + dynamic monthly metric columns
TeamName, YTD metrics + dynamic monthly metric columns

filters_supported.@FiscalYearCode: Accepted by signature but not used in internal WHERE clauses.
filters_supported.@MonthYear: Critical filter; used as exact IncentiveStartDate.
filters_supported.@AreaIDs: CSV area filter; interpreted as territory/district/region by role branch.
filters_supported.@GroupByIDs: Accepted by signature but not used in current logic.

date_logic.input_style: Single month start date as string
date_logic.computation: Uses FORMAT(IncentiveStartDate, 'MM-yyyy') for dynamic monthly column labeling.
date_logic.important: Procedure currently operates on provided month snapshot; multi-month trends require orchestrated multiple calls by router/service layer.

risk_drivers: Three dynamic SQL result sets per execution
Potential concurrency collision on global temp object
performance_risk.safe_pattern_hint: Best for incentive-domain questions scoped by month/team/role/area.
performance_risk.runtime_evidence: Single team single month run observed around 2.36s.
performance_risk.live_runtime: 0.40s narrow live sample: team 1, role 1, month 2025-07-01

anti_patterns.pattern: General sales volume/revenue trends without incentive context
anti_patterns.why_bad: SP is designed around incentive process tables and payout metrics.
No explicit finalized/locked status output column in final result sets.

routing_rules.when: Prompt asks incentive earned/net/deduction/achievement by employee, role, or team.
routing_rules.reason: Only this SP returns payout-oriented incentive metrics.

routing_rules.when: Prompt asks pure sales trend or sales-vs-target without incentive payout context.
routing_rules.reason: SVT is the dedicated aggregate sales/target SP.

Which distributor sold most units of product Z?

Should the summary be employee-level, role-level, or team-level?
